list: List of knowledge items retrieved successfully.
batchTag: Tags added to the knowledge items.
batchLink: Knowledge items linked to the chatbot.
uploadUrl: Upload URL created. PUT the file to it, then create the item with its fileKey.
unlink: Knowledge item removed from the chatbot.

error.batchTarget: Send either ids or a filter, not both. A filter also needs the knowledge base it applies to.
error.processing: This item is already being processed.
error.fileRequired: Attach a file to create a file item.
error.storageLimitExceeded: This file would go over your plan's knowledge storage. Delete some files or upgrade your plan to add more.
error.fileTypeInvalid: This file type cannot be read. Upload a PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown or HTML file.
error.mediaTypeInvalid: Media can be a JPG, PNG or WEBP image, or a PDF.
error.fileTooLarge: This file is too large. Images and documents can be up to 5MB, PDF media up to 20MB.
error.fileSource: A file or media item needs exactly one of fileKey or fileUrl. Other item types take neither.
error.uploadKeyInvalid: This fileKey does not belong to this knowledge base. Ask for a new upload URL.
error.uploadNotFound: No uploaded file was found for this fileKey. Upload the file to the upload URL first, or ask for a new one.
error.fileDownloadFailed: The file at this URL could not be downloaded. Use a public http or https link to the file itself.
error.uploadFailed: The file could not be saved. Please try again.

ingestFailed.title: Knowledge item failed
ingestFailed.message: "{title}" could not be processed, so your chatbots cannot use it. Open it to see why, then process it again.

linkSyncFailed.title: Knowledge item not available to chatbots
linkSyncFailed.message: "{title}" could not be connected to your chatbots, so they will not find it. Remove it from the chatbot and add it again.
